findings.summary: spi net /mcu/AUX_SPI_MOSI crosses GND plane gap
findings.description: spi signal /mcu/AUX_SPI_MOSI crosses a gap in GND plane on layer F.Cu.

findings.summary: GND plane split: 4 islands, 5 signals crossing
findings.description: GND plane has 4 disconnected islands. Signals crossing: /mcu/AV1, /mcu/AUX_SPI_MOSI, /mcu/AUX_SPI_MISO, /mcu/AUX_SPI_SCK, /mcu/AUX_SPI_CS.
findings.recommendation: Bridge the plane gap with copper pour or stitching vias. If zones were modified after the last fill, run KiCad Edit → Fill All Zones (B) and re-run the analyzer first — stale zone fills are a common cause of apparent plane splits.
